source.title: The tale of the Medieval Superhero #history #animation

transcript: Imagine yourself standing on a battlefield, heroically fighting off invaders, and then... Your arm is gone! Guts von der Belligingen, a knight of the late 15th century, lived a life as daring and resilient as any legend. Known for his bravery in countless battles across Europe, his story takes a dramatic turn in 1504 when he loses his hand to a cannonball. Unfazed, Guts replaces it with an iron prosthetic, earning him the nickname Guts of the Iron Hand. But it's not just his physical prowess that defines him. Guts became a symbol of deviance, standing against oppressive rulers and fighting for the rights of the common people. Almost like a medieval superhero.
